guitar.guitaristsText: John Lennon / George Harrison / Paul McCartney
guitar.modelsText: Rickenbacker 325/360-12, Gretsch, Epiphone Casino, Gibson J-160E
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: well documented across multiple guitars and eras — Lennon's Rickenbacker 325/Casino, Harrison's Gretsch/Rickenbacker 360-12, McCartney mainly bass (Hofner) with some guitar use.
guitar.notes: Original entry reasonable as a summary across three members and many guitars; kept as-is.

tone.target: jangly Vox-style edge-of-breakup rhythm with piano-room dryness
tone.profile: jangly Vox-style edge-of-breakup rhythm with piano-room dryness
tone.summary: A classic British rhythm tone using a light boost/OD for bite, followed by an AC30-style amp model, paired with a 2x12 cab, and finished with Chorus and Room reverb to achieve the desired Vox jangle and dryness.
corrections: name Vox chime more than generic rock

rig.name: The Beatles - Lady Madonna - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray hum and background noise.
Provide the necessary 'rhythmic drive' and upper-mid bite without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen for its bright, slightly nasal character, mimicking a light Vox/British clean boost effect.

alternatives.model: Blues OD (if more grit is needed)

blocks.gap: The Green OD handles the necessary crunch; a dedicated DST unit is unnecessary and would muddy the chime.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic British chime and open-back sound associated with Vox amps.

alternatives.model: UK 45 (if a slightly more aggressive tone is desired)

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, open-sounding cabinet image that complements the AC30 tone.
blocks.gap: While UK Vintage 4x12 is common for this genre, US 2x12 was selected to match the 'open-back' and brighter chime clue.

alternatives.model: UK Basket 4x12 (if a more traditional British sound is preferred)

blocks.purpose: Enhance the upper-mid bite and 'jangly' quality while keeping the tone focused.
blocks.gap: Manual EQ adjustment is necessary to dial in the specific Vox chime character that standard models might miss.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle width and movement to the rhythm parts, enhancing the 'chime' effect.
blocks.gap: Chorus is used here not for obvious modulation, but for its ability to widen and brighten the signal subtly, fitting the jangle requirement.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required 'piano-room dryness' and subtle ambience without sounding modern or thick.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a more controlled, less natural decay is acceptable)

blocks.purpose: Optional: Kept off to maintain the dry, rhythmic focus.
blocks.gap: The 'rhythmic drive' and dryness are best achieved without noticeable delay repeats.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture open-back, British chime tones.

proposals.reason: Better captures the desired Vox/open-back sound than US 2x12.
